mechanism_claims.claim_text: HeLa CC50 values in Table 3 and the source discussion support that loop 2 and loop 3 hydrophobic residues are most important for cytotoxicity, with loop 1 Ser-7 and loop 5 Val-26 also contributing.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper proposes a bracelet-cyclotide membrane-binding model in which a bioactive face helps initial membrane localization and hydrophobic residues drive membrane-core insertion that could disturb lipid bilayers.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: hyen D / typical bracelet cyclotide model
mechanism_claims.limitations: The membrane-disintegration step is a proposed model integrating prior cyclotide literature and this paper’s binding/cytotoxicity data; no new direct bilayer-disruption assay is reported here.
